mediaWork.title: Actual Innocence
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Direct first-person interviews with exonerees and wrongful conviction advocates.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Interview-driven podcast hosted by Brooke Gittings (72 episodes) giving wrongfully convicted and exonerated individuals a platform to tell their own stories of arrest, trial, incarceration, and life after exoneration.
